name: Gifto
rootCause: In November 2024, the Gifto project team exercised privileged mint authority to create 1.2 billion new GFT tokens immediately after Binance announced GFT delisting. The new tokens were distributed across team wallets, deposited onto exchanges, and dumped on the market, collapsing GFT’s price and inflicting estimated losses of $10 million on holders. Centralized privileged minting allowed the Gifto team to inflate GFT supply without any enforced cap or multisig control. The team exploited this function after a delisting announcement, flooding exchanges and devaluing the token.
